official_local_manuals.name: reboot(2)
official_local_manuals.relevant_contract: Programs other than reboot(8) should use shutdown(8) or a higher-level API for a clean shutdown. Success does not return; EPERM denotes missing super-user privilege. Without RB_NOSYNC the kernel syncs disks.

official_local_manuals.name: shutdown(8)
official_local_manuals.relevant_contract: -r restarts, -h halts and powers off; now requests immediate action. Without -o shutdown sends the corresponding signal to launchd. Running processes receive SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after an indeterminate interval to flush data and exit; no GUI unsaved-document prompt contract is documented.
